stem: A pharmacy revises its Schedule II workflow for support personnel. Select all supported requirements.

choices.text: The personnel category must be authorized by 247 CMR 8.05 for the assigned handling step.
Every technician trainee may independently receive Schedule II stock.
The pharmacist remains responsible for required supervision and final professional functions.
A cashier may perform any Schedule II task if the manager consents.
Schedule II handling is exempt from personnel-scope rules.
